chapter.heading: A song for pilgrims going up to Jerusalem. A psalm of Solomon.
chapter.v:
If the
Lord doesn't build the house, the work of the builders is futile. If the Lord doesn't guard the city, the work of the guards is pointless.

It's useless
to get up early in the morning and go to work, and stay late into the evening, worrying about earning enough to eat, when the Lord gives rest to those he loves.

Children certainly
are a gift from the Lord, for a family is a blessing.

Like arrows
in the hand of a warrior are the children of a young man.

Happy is
the father who fills his quiver with them! Such fathers will not be embarrassed when they confront their enemies at the city gate.
